mapper.sql: id , project_name, branch_name, commit_author, commit_message, diff_code, file_count, additions, deletions, file_list, review_result, ai_model, status, error_message, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_review_record (project_name, branch_name, commit_author, commit_message, diff_code, file_count, additions, deletions, file_list, review_result, ai_model, status, error_message, create_time) VALUES (#{projectName}, #{branchName}, #{commitAuthor}, #{commitMessage}, #{diffCode}, #{fileCount}, #{additions}, #{deletions}, #{fileList}, #{reviewResult}, #{aiModel}, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.project_name, r.branch_name, r.commit_author, r.commit_message, r.diff_code, r.file_count, r.additions, r.deletions, r.file_list, r.review_result, r.ai_model, r.status, r.error_message, r.create_time FROM t_review_record r
INNER JOIN t_review_issue i ON r.id = i.review_id AND i.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND r.project_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{projectName}, '%')
AND r.commit_author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{author}, '%')
AND (r.commit_message LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.review_result LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
SELECT project_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_review_record GROUP BY project_name ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT commit_author AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_review_record GROUP BY commit_author ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(ai_model, ''), '未知模型') AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_review_record GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(ai_model, ''), '未知模型') ORDER BY count DESC
